text:
I just finished my first half marathon in Bengaluru! 🏃

21.1 km. 2:05:30.

My biggest lesson from getting here: **consistency beat motivation.**

Motivation came and went. What carried me to the finish line was showing up anyway, run after run, whether I felt like it or not. Small, steady efforts added up to something I'm really proud of.

A huge thank you to my running group, **Sunday Striders**. Your company and encouragement made this journey so much better.

First half marathon: done. ✅

#HalfMarathon #Running #Bengaluru
